cases.title: compressed
cases.behavior: Every original asserted request URL/header and response status/header/body projection is checked against literals. Hono removes explicitly supplied Accept-Encoding; gateway forwards it. Both expect Fetch-decoded response metadata.

cases.title: uncompressed
cases.behavior: Every original asserted request URL/header and response status/header/body projection is checked against literals. Request encoding negotiation differs; uncompressed response length remains valid in both.

cases.title: POST request
cases.behavior: Every original asserted request URL/header and response status/header/body projection is checked against literals. Shared original expectations.

cases.title: remove hop-by-hop headers
cases.behavior: Every original asserted request URL/header and response status/header/body projection is checked against literals. Gateway strips caller Host and Connection-nominated fields; default Hono intentionally keeps the nominated Custom-Header.

cases.title: remove hop-by-hop headers with strictConnectionProcessing
cases.behavior: Every original asserted request URL/header and response status/header/body projection is checked against literals. Strict request nomination removal agrees; gateway still removes caller-selected Host.

cases.title: invalid hop-by-hop headers with strictConnectionProcessing
cases.behavior: Every original asserted request URL/header and response status/header/body projection is checked against literals. Hono strict mode rejects malformed nomination syntax; generic gateway forwarding ignores invalid tokens while stripping valid nominations.

cases.title: specify hop-by-hop header by options
cases.behavior: Every original asserted request URL/header and response status/header/body projection is checked against literals. Explicit Hono init may restore a hop credential; gateway transport policy strips it and forbids trusted adapter patches from restoring it.

cases.title: remove response headers listed in the Connection header
cases.behavior: Every original asserted request URL/header and response status/header/body projection is checked against literals. Shared original expectations.

cases.title: modify header
cases.behavior: Every original asserted request URL/header and response status/header/body projection is checked against literals. Shared original expectations.

cases.title: does not propagate undefined request headers
cases.behavior: Every original asserted request URL/header and response status/header/body projection is checked against literals. Hono deletes an explicit undefined override; gateway uses its declared default credential stripping policy instead of accepting undefined Headers values.

cases.title: client disconnect
cases.behavior: Original POST body test and abort reason client disconnect; Hono original response body preserved. Abort timing gated at actual upstream entry; gateway caller abort rejects exact reason and late response cancellation is joined.

cases.title: not found
cases.behavior: Every original asserted request URL/header and response status/header/body projection is checked against literals. Shared original expectations.

cases.title: pass a Request object to proxyInit
cases.behavior: Every original asserted request URL/header and response status/header/body projection is checked against literals. Hono accepts Request as its init overload; gateway accepts a native Request through its Fetch handler. Encoding negotiation differs.
